_about: Sign-up, confirmation, unsubscribe, contact, push, health, the static customer pages, and every email template the site and its two services send. Checks: e2e/checks/audience.mjs. Templates with no way to render them without sending are gaps until a token-gated preview exists (see the report).

extra.email:subscribe-confirmation: The 'confirm your subscription' email, EN and ES (server/src/routes/subscribe.ts sendVerificationEmail). The same template is sent by the sign-up, by the resend button on subscribe-pending.html, by the pending-subscriber reminder (lib/subscriber-hygiene.ts), and in its 'track this ship' variant by the track-signup flow. Links: /api/verify-email?token=, /api/unsubscribe?email=&sig=.
extra.email:contact-confirmation: The 'Got it, I'll be in touch within 24 hours' email to someone who submits a Work With Mark or cabin-request form (server/src/routes/contact.ts sendConfirmationEmail). Links: the YouTube channel.
extra.email:contact-alert-to-mark: The 'New Work With Mark Inquiry' email to Mark (APPROVAL_EMAIL) with every field of the form (server/src/routes/contact.ts sendInternalAlert). Links: the home page.
extra.email:newsletter-weekly: The weekly newsletter, English and Spanish editions (server/src/lib/newsletter.ts renderEnrichedNewsletter, sent by startNewsletterSend after Mark approves). Preview: GET /api/newsletter/email?lang=en|es.
extra.email:newsletter-composer-legacy: The older composer newsletter (server/src/routes/subscribe.ts renderNewsletter, POST /api/send-newsletter) — emails every confirmed subscriber at once, English only.
extra.email:storm-alert: The storm alert email to opted-in subscribers, EN/ES (server/src/lib/storm-email-content.ts stormAlertEmailHtml, sent by lib/storm-send.ts emailSubscribers). Links: per-ship tracker links, Where's My Ship, Storm Watch, unsubscribe.
extra.email:storm-all-clear: The storm all-clear email, EN/ES (storm-email-content.ts allClearEmailHtml, lib/storm-send.ts emailAllClear) — same buttons as the alert.
extra.email:ship-watch-started: The 'you're now tracking <ship>' email (trackingEmail, sent by POST /api/wms/watch, routes/track-signup.ts and lib/pending-watches.ts when a sign-up is confirmed). Links: stop-tracking link, Where's My Ship.
extra.email:ship-watch-alert: The Ship Watch alert email: itinerary change, severe weather, cruise-line news for a watched ship, EN/ES (lib/wms-alerts.ts renderAlertEmail). Links: stop-tracking link, Where's My Ship.
extra.email:mark-notification-floor: The plain-text email Mark gets when a high-priority or lead notification reaches no push device (lib/notify.ts notifyMark email floor) — includes group-page interest leads.
extra.email:morning-brief: Mark's morning brief email (lib/brief.ts renderBriefEmail, sent by runAndDeliverBrief). Preview: GET /api/brief/email-preview.
extra.email:editorial-digest: The news agent's 'AI Editorial Digest' email to Mark after a news scan (stillafloat-newsagent src/lib/email-delivery.ts renderEditorialDigest / sendEditorialDigest).
extra.email:channel-workday: The ops-manager's 'Channel workday' email to Mark (saf-ops-manager agent/channel_workday.py, via agent/gmail.py send_email).
extra.flow:confirmation-email-links: Following the confirm and unsubscribe links from a subscriber email: where they land, and that a forged link changes no subscriber.
extra.flow:spanish-unsubscribe: A Spanish subscriber clicking 'Cancelar suscripción' lands on a Spanish confirmation page.
extra.flow:turnstile-enforced: The server itself refuses sign-up and contact requests with no (or a forged) Turnstile token, in the visitor's language.
extra.flow:storm-email-buttons: The buttons and ship links in the storm alert / all-clear emails open pages with real content (Storm Watch list, Where's My Ship deep links), EN and ES.
extra.flow:subscribe-success: A real sign-up end to end: row saved as pending, confirmation email delivered, link clicked, row confirmed, pending ship watches switched on, welcome page shown.
extra.flow:contact-success: A real Work With Mark submission end to end: prospect row saved, confirmation email to the visitor, alert email to Mark.
extra.flow:subscriber-admin-writes: The successful paths of the subscriber admin actions: changing a subscriber's newsletter language, marking an address bounced (ops-manager bounce scanner), resending a confirmation.
extra.push:device-registration: Registering and removing a push device for Mark's alerts (POST /api/push/subscribe and /unsubscribe) and the device count they report.
extra.push:alert-delivery: A push notification actually reaching Mark's devices (POST /api/push/test, /api/push/notify, notifyMark).
extra.push:operator-devices: How many of Mark's devices are registered for alerts on each box, as the other box's watchdog reads it from GET /api/healthz/alerts with the canary token.

email:subscribe-confirmation.reason: No way to render it without sending it: the only callers insert a subscriber and email them, and the dev box sends real email. Its two links are covered by flow:confirmation-email-links. Needs a token-gated preview endpoint (fixture name, EN/ES, watch-ship variant).

email:contact-confirmation.reason: Only rendered inside a successful contact submission, which saves a prospect and emails the visitor and Mark. Needs a token-gated preview endpoint.

email:contact-alert-to-mark.reason: Only rendered inside a successful contact submission, which emails Mark. Needs a token-gated preview endpoint.

email:newsletter-composer-legacy.reason: Rendered only by POST /api/send-newsletter, which emails every confirmed subscriber; only its refusals are tested (audience.subscriber-admin-refusals). Needs a preview, or retiring in favour of the weekly newsletter.

email:storm-alert.reason: Rendered only inside the subscriber send (lib/storm-send.ts); no preview endpoint. Its fixed buttons and ship links are covered by flow:storm-email-buttons, but the body as sent is not.

email:storm-all-clear.reason: Rendered only inside the all-clear send; no preview endpoint. Its buttons are the same as the alert's and are covered by flow:storm-email-buttons.

email:ship-watch-started.reason: Rendered only when a watch is saved (which also buys a Live-AIS position and emails the subscriber); no preview endpoint.

email:ship-watch-alert.reason: Rendered only inside the watch sweep that emails watchers; no preview endpoint. Its stop link is a side-effecting GET.

email:mark-notification-floor.reason: Sent only when a high-priority notification fails every push channel; triggering it emails Mark. Needs a dry-run mode on notifyMark.

email:editorial-digest.reason: The news agent renders it only inside a news scan (which runs paid model calls) and has no preview route; the news agent is also stopped on the dev box.

email:channel-workday.reason: The ops-manager renders it only inside the workday job, which also texts Mark; no preview route.

flow:subscribe-success.reason: Completing a sign-up needs a real Turnstile token and sends a real confirmation email from the dev box; only the refusals and the forged-link paths can be exercised. Needs a dev-only Turnstile test key pair plus a mail sink.

flow:contact-success.reason: A successful submission saves a prospect and emails the visitor and Mark; only refusals are tested. Needs a Turnstile test key pair and a mail sink on dev.

flow:subscriber-admin-writes.reason: The success paths change a real subscriber row and there is no way to create a fixture subscriber without a real sign-up (see flow:subscribe-success); only refusals and not-found paths are tested.

push:alert-delivery.reason: Delivering a push reaches Mark's phone; only the refusals (no token, empty message) are tested.

push:operator-devices.reason: GET /api/healthz/alerts needs CANARY_TOKEN, which the sweep is not given; only its refusals are tested. Covered indirectly: audience.health-and-push-key fails on prod if the push-health sweep has an open 'reaching nobody' fault for today or yesterday, and audience.push-device-roundtrip holds dev's device count against that same fault. The count itself on prod is still not readable.
